priorArt: W33-Theory THE_27_FOLD_WAY.md and Passes 370-372, 386; Holotrade gq24_lives_inside_w33_as_its_octet_factors.py and 5419c27 (frames).
theorem: in Stab(p0) = 3^{1+2}:SL(2,3) the 27 SL(2,3) complements of the elation (qutrit Pauli) group fall into three conjugacy classes of 9; the bulk-point stabilisers and the frame (cubic-surface line) stabilisers lie in different classes; the automorphisms g -> g z^{s chi(g)}, chi the abelianisation character onto Z3 and z the central phase, cycle the three classes; the W(E6)-stabiliser of p0 fixes every class.
reading: Pass 371's permutation isomorphism of the two 27s exists only through such a character twist and is not induced by W(E6); Pass 372's non-geometricity is a property of the bulk points, since the E6 27 is geometric as frames; Pass 386's phase gap is exactly the twist by the central qutrit phase. The three torsors are indexed by the one-dimensional characters of SL(2,3) = 2T, which McKay places at the three extremal nodes of affine E6 -- a structural parallel only; no generation assignment.
boundary: exact finite computation with exhaustive complement enumeration; no natural W(3,3) object realising the third class was found among lines, hyperbolic lines, octets, spreads and frame pairs; no physical identification is made.
